# Album Amicorum

## Articles

[Friendship Book for Kids: The Complete Guide to Keepsakes](https://www.albumamicorum.com/articles/friendship-book-for-kids/): Discover what a friendship book for kids really is, why it matters, and how to choose a beautifully illustrated keepsake your child will treasure for life.

[Friend Books for Kids: The Ultimate Childhood Keepsake Guide](https://www.albumamicorum.com/articles/friend-books-for-kids/): Discover what a Friend Book really is, why childhood friendships deserve one, and how to choose an illustrated keepsake kids will treasure for life.

[Friendship Book for Kids: FAQ for Parents and Gift-Givers](https://www.albumamicorum.com/articles/friendship-book-for-kids-questions/): Still wondering if a friendship book is right for your child? Honest answers on age, what goes inside, how it works, and why kids keep using it.

[How to Start a Kids' Friendship Book: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.albumamicorum.com/articles/how-to-start-a-friendship-book-for-kids/): A parent's practical guide to starting a friendship book with kids — from setting up the very first page to building a keepsake that lasts for decades.

[7 Occasions That Call for Giving a Friendship Book for Kids](https://www.albumamicorum.com/articles/when-to-give-a-friendship-book-for-kids/): From the last day of school to a family move, these 7 moments are when a friendship book for kids stops feeling like a gift and starts feeling like a must.
